summary: Elevate your expertise in knowledge management with our AI and data-focused e-library training course. Discover innovative techniques to optimize learning!
lede: AI and data-driven knowledge management helps professionals turn scattered information into searchable, reusable knowledge through a well-structured e-library. It is for librarians, records and knowledge managers, and program, research, or learning teams responsible for organizing information. Participants learn to design e-library structures, improve metadata and search, use AI-assisted tagging and summaries with human review, and apply analytics and governance to keep content useful and reliable.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across various sectors who are responsible for managing and optimizing knowledge systems.
audience: Knowledge management (KM) officers and information managers
Compliance, audit, legal, and risk staff
modules: Metadata and Taxonomy That Actually Works
AI for Tagging, Classification, and Summarization
Capturing Tacit Knowledge and Institutional Memory
Data Quality, Trust, and Content Lifecycle Management
Analytics and KPIs for Knowledge Value
Knowledge Management for Programs, Grants, and Research
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of knowledge management principles and familiarity with digital tools used in document and information management.
